# Saylo 0.4.7
## Integrated beta - Includes the reviewed microphone, per-app delivery, local formatting, vocabulary, appearance and recent-dictation recovery improvements. - Prepares safer subscription activation recovery when a future paid release enables licensing. - This public beta remains free and uncapped, with licensing disabled. - Locally signed and unnotarized; no installation or permissions are changed automatically.
# Saylo 0.4.6
## Interface - The live status overlay can sit on the MacBook camera island, and floating chrome follows Auto, Light or Dark. - About opens the public Saylo website, privacy and support pages. - Settings include microphone choice with a short local level test, and per-app delivery: live, final only, or copy only.
## Beta - This beta remains free and uncapped; billing is not enabled. - This remains a locally signed, unnotarized beta for controlled testing.
# Saylo 0.4.5
## Integrated beta - Includes the live editor continuity fixes, safer Terminal delivery, local diagnostic traces and recent-dictation recovery from the latest beta series. - Prepares optional future subscription management. This beta remains free and uncapped; billing is not enabled. - Updates developer and distribution information for the Saylo website. - This remains a locally signed, unnotarized beta for controlled testing.
# Saylo 0.4.4
## Live editor continuity - Accept an empty editor’s paragraph marker disappearing after the first paste, only when the full inserted draft and caret match exactly. This prevents a false read-back mismatch from stopping the next words. - Preserve actual newlines when the editor keeps them, and never accept missing real document context as empty-editor normalization.
## Local diagnostic traces - Per-dictation session IDs and relative timings follow recording, queued recognition, preview sizes, replacement ranges, caret positions, dispatch and confirmation. - Terminal interruptions distinguish physical input, window/focus, secure input and recognition changes. - Export Diagnostics includes these numeric operational traces. Dictated words, clipboard content and audio are never logged or uploaded automatically.
# Saylo 0.4.3
## Beta update validation - Publishes the signed beta update offered to the 0.4.2 installer so you can test Check for Updates, download, installation and relaunch. - Includes the live dictation, recent-result recovery and quieter interface improvements from 0.4.2. - This remains a locally signed, unnotarized beta. The receiving apps and actual update installation require manual verification.
# Saylo 0.4.2
## Live dictation - Growing previews append only the new suffix; revisions replace only the changed tail. - Faster adaptive preview scheduling avoids adding a full pause after each recognition pass. - Apple Terminal uses a separate append-only path for words agreed across partial results. It never selects or erases terminal screen contents or submits a command. - Typing, clicking, changing focus or secure input stops terminal delivery; conflicting final wording remains available for recovery. - Empty editor hints are excluded only when Accessibility confirms zero document characters. New count-only diagnostics help investigate custom editors.
## Recovering your words - Click the screen-edge island or use Recent Dictations in the menu bar to recover the last 10 results, with Copy and Paste. - Recent dictations stay in memory for this session and clear when Saylo quits. Secure input is excluded. - Result cards count down for four seconds and fade away; hovering or a failed paste pauses dismissal. - Paste dismisses the card after the native shortcut is posted. The result stays recoverable even if the receiving app cannot confirm delivery. - The newest-word marker is quieter and does not blink for every partial result.
## Signed beta updates - Direct-download builds include a public HTTPS beta feed and an Ed25519 update verification key. - Automatic checks remain optional and off by default; source code stays in the private repository. - This is a locally signed, unnotarized beta for testing. Native ChatGPT and terminal delivery still need testing on the receiving app.
# Saylo 0.4.1
## Installer - Show the bundle assembly time in Toronto time, including the correct EDT or EST abbreviation. - Timestamp the bundle after compilation so the installer does not show the start of a long build. - Refresh the app, disk image and launch-preparation package together for local testing.
# Saylo 0.4.0
## Improved dictation - Live drafts use native paste events and wait for asynchronous editor read-back. - Final wording waits for an in-flight preview, avoiding duplicated draft text on key release. - Focus lookup also queries the frontmost app directly when system-wide focus is unavailable. - Only one Saylo recording session can run at a time.
## Learning from edits - User edits stop live replacement so corrected text is preserved. - Corrections to live drafts, completed dictation and manually pasted results can be learned in supported fields. - A correction becomes automatic after three confirmations and at least a 75% majority over alternatives. - Learned words stay local; the speech model is not retrained and no text is uploaded.
## Reliability and interface - Dictation waits until the speech model is loaded; failed loading offers a retry from the menu bar. - Recovery cards stay available, scroll long text, and remain open when paste cannot be confirmed. - Show Last Result recovers the latest non-secure result from memory.
## Branding and privacy - All current project branding, identifiers and active storage use Saylo. - About and Settings include Marloo Creative Studio and info@marloo.net. - Correction logs contain counts, never the corrected words. - Preview and final pastes preserve the original clipboard even when they overlap.
# Saylo 0.3.1
## Fixed - Recheck permission status immediately when returning from System Settings, with a manual Check Again action. - Explain enabled-but-ineffective permission entries for temporary signed previews, with quit/reopen guidance. - Match the Accessibility guide to macOS 27's Device Control and Data Access section. - Prevent normal DMG packaging from creating an ad-hoc installer that can lose permission identity across rebuilds.
## Diagnostics - Include the running app's signature type in startup logs and exported reports.
# Saylo 0.3.0
## Added - Check for Updates from the menu bar and Settings in configured direct-download builds. - Optional automatic update checks. Installation asks for your confirmation. - Version and build numbers, release notes, and diagnostic export in Settings. - Clear drag-to-Applications instructions, version and EST release timestamp in the disk image. - Permission rechecks and recovery guidance for macOS switches that are enabled but not effective for this build. - Focus and delivery diagnostics to help investigate chat fields that do not accept dictation.
## Improved - Applied Saylo branding across the application and release tools. - Live-text diagnostics distinguish focus, caret, text, and write failures. - Paste logs distinguish a sent keyboard shortcut from confirmed delivery. - Simulation logs record character counts instead of text. - Normal DMG packaging rejects ad-hoc builds; local previews are explicitly named to distinguish them from stable installers.
## Release status The updater requires a published HTTPS update feed, an update verification key, and signed release archives. Mac App Store builds use Apple's update mechanism instead.
